title: Trump LIVE: Trump's Middle Finger Flash at Ford Worker in Michigan Goes Viral
text: Trump LIVE: Trump's Middle Finger Flash at Ford Worker in Michigan Goes ViralA routine presidential visit to a Ford facility in Michigan has spiralled into controversy after a video appeared to show Donald Trump gesturing a raised middle finger at a heckler. The incident, captured by multiple cameras and widely shared online, has overshadowed the visit’s focus on jobs, growth, and the economy ahead of the midterms. Reports say the heckler shouted an insult linked to Trump’s past associations. The White House has defended the president’s response, but critics have called the moment unpresidential. Supporters, however, praise Trump’s blunt style, underscoring a deeply divided America.
